reason: Tried derive_builder: every call site builds inside a LazyLock::new(|| ...) closure that cannot propagate build()'s Result, so the builder forced .expect() at ~33 sites -- real new panic sites in library code, confirmed by this crate's own panics etiquette (64 abort-site findings). The plain constructor enforces completeness at compile time with zero runtime fallibility, which is strictly safer for data that is always fully specified. User-approved exception.
